results.query: What minimum age does UNESCO recommend for independent conversations with GenAI platforms?

result.summary: No binding rule for your case was found in the knowledge base; only non-binding or foreign context is available.

context_examples.title: Guidance for generative AI in education and research
context_examples.quote: The emergence of various GenAI chatbots demand that countries carefully consider – and publicly deliberate – the appropriate age threshold for independent conversations with GenAI platforms. The minimum threshold should be 13 years of age.
context_examples.attribution: Fengchun Miao and Wayne Holmes / Guidance for generative AI in education and research / ISBN 978-92-3-100612-8 / © UNESCO 2023 / licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
context_examples.context_note: Recommendation addressed to countries about the age threshold for independent conversations with GenAI platforms. It is not a UAE legal age limit or blanket authorization for all classroom uses. Local law, institutional rules, service terms and supervision must be checked separately.

context_examples.title: Guidance for generative AI in education and research
context_examples.quote: Age appropriateness: Consider implementing minimum age restrictions for the independent use of GenAI in the institution.
context_examples.attribution: Fengchun Miao and Wayne Holmes / Guidance for generative AI in education and research / ISBN 978-92-3-100612-8 / © UNESCO 2023 / licensed under CC BY-SA 3.0 IGO
context_examples.context_note: Recommendation to educational authorities and institutions concerning independent use of GenAI within an institution. This sentence does not specify a numerical age threshold.

result.safe_next_step: Check the course syllabus or ask the instructor in writing; keep a disclosure of any AI use.
